steps.what: Review overhaul documents against equipment identity, repair evidence and test results
Sign overhaul documents for replaced or repaired equipment within signing authority

tasks.design: Keep evidence review and signing with the authorised repairer, using the current document in {DOCS}. Test native signature and reference access before a new workflow; signing a prepared document contains no established duplicated drafting step to remove.
tasks.previous_blocker: A signature depends on evidence, equipment identity and the signer's actual authority.
tasks.enabler_now: Digital document tools can record signatures without replacing the signing judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising incomplete repair evidence or a document beyond the signer's scope.
tasks.human_edge: Accountable assessment of what the repair and test evidence actually supports.
tasks.altitude: Signing accountability and evidence-review time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Clarify an incomplete overhaul evidence packet

evidence.claim: AMOS Production supports digital work-order completion and integrated signatures in aircraft maintenance; that does not establish labour savings for this industrial equipment signing task.
Evidence review and accountable signing remain human; no duplicated document-preparation baseline is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary is reviewing and signing an already prepared overhaul document, excluding repairs, test execution and initial report preparation; those retain separate labour.

Repair and test staff produce the document and underlying evidence before s1. Repairer checks equipment/serial ID, document version, work references, test records and scope during s1; missing evidence is obtained manually, with review time fully retained.
No machine assumes a free passed-test flag, completed evidence manifest or signer-authorisation decision. Existing authority is confirmed during signing.
Native document signature and reference access are the first options. No new system or capture requirement means zero incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Is any clerical copying distinct from evidence review and signing actually present?

incremental.description: No added upkeep or transferred work

approvals.approved_version: Exact overhaul document version, equipment identity and linked repair/test evidence; any change voids the signature approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=75+25=100, gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Existing document runtime and upstream report writing earn no savings in the signing boundary.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retains evidence review and signing accountability.
reach: Resolve evidence gaps with maintenance supervisors
role.ambitious_version: A repairer whose signed documents clearly trace to the equipment and work they attest to.

job.title: Electrical and Electronics Repairers, Commercial and Industrial Equipment
